thread:
noah: Starting v2.21 deploy. Plan: enable `rec-routing-v2` as staged-unblock: OFF -> 2% -> 10% -> 50% -> 100%, with safety-drain hooks and model pin during early stages. Change window 00:30-01:30 UTC. Posting steps.

 deploy-bot: [deploy] v2.21 pushed to prod-cluster-6. Canary bucket = cohort-routing-canary.

 keiko: Pinning model for canary: `/infra pin-model --svc rec-router --ver rwd-model-2026-04-15 --until 50pct` so we don't get drift in the routed baseline.

 noah: Starting staged unblock to 2% now:
`/ff set rec-routing-v2 --target 2 --reason "v2.21 staged unblock step1"`

 deploy-bot: Flag set to 2% -> success. Telemetry snapshot: error-rate +0.06%, p95 +8ms, route-miss ~0.9%. Safety-drain thresholds: error_delta >1.0% OR p95 +180ms OR embedding-queue >150 -> auto-drain.

 sre-lead: Ops criteria: if error-rate delta >0.8% sustained for 5m or p99 +250ms -> cut to 0% and run rollback. Also watch model memory on dedicated GPU nodes.

 deploy-bot: Advancing to 10% in 20m unless flagged. Current metrics stable.

 keiko: enabling 10% now: `/ff set rec-routing-v2 --target 10 --reason "v2.21 step2"` 

 deploy-bot: 10% -> success. Telemetry: error +0.15%, p95 +20ms, mem 68%. No circuit trips.

 noah: Running quick production smoke for internal cohort `int-smoke` for 10m. If smoke passes, schedule 50% in +40m. Rollback plan if smoke fails:
1) `/ff set rec-routing-v2 --target 0 --force --reason "smoke-fail-rollback"`
2) `/infra rollback-release --id v2.21 --drain 45s`
3) `/infra unpin-model --svc rec-router`

 ops-oncall: standing by. I'll mute low priority noise and monitor: p50/p95/p99, error-rate by route, model mem, queue depth. Curl snippet for emergency drain: `curl -XPOST -H \"Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN\" \"https://api.redwood/flags/rec-routing-v2?action=set&target=0&force=true\"`

 deploy-bot: Smoke run OK. Proceeding to 50% as scheduled.

 keiko: lifting pin after 50% stable: `/infra unpin-model --svc rec-router` will be executed only after 50% soak confirmed.

 deploy-bot: 50% -> success. Telemetry stable. No SLO regressions. Scheduling 100% flip in maintenance window at 01:10 UTC unless any guard trips.

 noah: If we abort at any point: 1) hit the curl snippet, 2) file an incident and notify #incidents, 3) attach the `/logs ff rec-routing-v2 --last 30m` output to the incident. I'll post final status at the 01:10 flip. Thanks all.
